title: Smart Class Scheduling
subtitle: Prepare inputs, review suggested plans, and publish the final schedule

workflow.title: Scheduling workflow
workflow.description: The system checks term data, creates valid alternatives, and keeps the final decision with the supervisor.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.description: Complete class requirements and availability data.

generate.title: Generate
generate.description: The engine creates and ranks conflict-free alternatives.

review.title: Supervisor review
review.description: Compare suggestions and adjust details when needed.

publish.title: Publish classes
publish.description: Validate the selected plan and convert it into real classes.

ready.title: Your scheduling workspace is ready
ready.description: Before creating the first plan, review the active term, teacher qualifications and availability, and student time profiles.

generation.title: Create scheduling suggestions
generation.description: Choose the scheduling scope and the class requirements the engine should include.

branch.label: Branch scope
branch.description: Optional — narrow the suggestions to one branch.

requirements.label: Class requirements
requirements.description: Select at least one active requirement to schedule.
requirements.empty: No active requirements match this scope
requirements.emptyHint: Review class requirements or choose another branch.
requirements.chooseTermHint: Its active class requirements will appear here.

validation.requirements: Select at least one class requirement.

instituteRequired.title: Select an institute
instituteRequired.description: Choose an institute from the header before starting a scheduling run.

QUEUED.title: Waiting to start
QUEUED.description: The request is queued and will start automatically. You can keep this page open.

GENERATING.title: Generating scheduling suggestions
GENERATING.description: The engine is checking constraints and ranking the available scheduling options.

COMPLETED.title: Suggestions are ready
COMPLETED.description: Generation finished successfully and the plans are ready for supervisor review.

PREFLIGHT_FAILED.title: Inputs need attention
PREFLIGHT_FAILED.description: Generation could not start because one or more required inputs are incomplete or incompatible.

FAILED.title: Generation failed
FAILED.description: The engine could not finish this run. Review the message below and try again.

CANCELLED.title: Generation was cancelled
CANCELLED.description: This run stopped before producing scheduling suggestions.

connectionError.title: Status could not be refreshed
connectionError.description: The run is still preserved. Check your connection and try refreshing its status.

result.title: {count} scheduling suggestions generated
result.recommended: The engine has also identified a recommended plan for review.
result.noRecommendation: Review the generated alternatives and choose the best fit.

comparison.title: Compare suggested plans
comparison.description: Review every option against the same criteria. The engine recommendation is guidance; the supervisor keeps the final decision.

loading.title: Preparing the comparison
loading.description: Loading the details of the generated plans.

error.title: Plan comparison could not be loaded
error.description: The run result is safe. Try loading the plan details again.

planDetails.title: Plan {rank} details
planDetails.description: Review the suggested classes and unresolved requirements before making a final decision.

noProposals.title: No feasible classes were generated
noProposals.description: Review the unresolved requirements below to understand why.

warningMessages.GENERATION_PENDING: This plan has not finished generating.
warningMessages.MISSING_SCHEDULED_CLASSES: Some required classes could not be generated.
warningMessages.NEUTRAL_TIME_GROUP_USED: A neutral time group was used.
warningMessages.TIME_PATTERN_NOT_DIVERSE: The odd/even or morning/evening mix is incomplete.
warningMessages.TIME_GROUP_IMBALANCED: Classes are not balanced across time groups.
warningMessages.MANUAL_EDIT_REQUIRES_VALIDATION: This class must be validated again after its manual edit.

warningContexts.classCount: {scheduled} of {required} required classes could be scheduled.

unresolvedReasons.INVALID_REQUIREMENT: The class requirement is incomplete or invalid.
unresolvedReasons.NO_VALID_TEACHER: No active valid teacher was found.
unresolvedReasons.NO_QUALIFIED_TEACHER: No teacher is qualified for this course.
unresolvedReasons.NO_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY: No compatible teacher availability was found.
unresolvedReasons.TEACHER_TIME_CONFLICT: Available times conflict with the teacher schedule.
unresolvedReasons.INSUFFICIENT_CLASSROOM_CAPACITY: Available classrooms do not have enough capacity.
unresolvedReasons.CLASSROOM_TIME_CONFLICT: The classroom is unavailable at feasible times.
unresolvedReasons.NO_FEASIBLE_TIME_SLOT: No feasible time slot was found.
unresolvedReasons.INSUFFICIENT_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATES: There were not enough feasible candidates.
unresolvedReasons.PLAN_COMBINATION_CONFLICT: This class conflicted with the final plan combination.
